from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TPS23861_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8  # Register width

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x80,  # INTERRUPT
            0x02: 0x00,  # POWER_EVENT
            0x04: 0x00,  # DETECT_EVENT
            0x06: 0x00,  # FAULT_EVENT
            0x08: 0x00,  # START_EVENT
            0x0A: 0x30,  # SUPPLY_EVENT
            0x0C: 0x00,  # PORT1_STATUS
            0x0D: 0x00,  # PORT2_STATUS
            0x0E: 0x00,  # PORT3_STATUS
            0x0F: 0x00,  # PORT4_STATUS
            0x10: 0x00,  # POWER_STATUS
            0x17: 0x80,  # GENERAL_MASK
            0x18: 0x00,  # RESTART
            0x19: 0x00,  # POWER_ENABLE
            0x1A: 0x00,  # RESET_CMD
            0x27: 0x00,  # INTERRUPT_TIMER
            0x2C: 0x00,  # TEMPERATURE
            0x40: 0x00,  # POE_PLUS
            0xFE: 0x00   # FIRMWARE_REV
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        else:
            return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if nbytes == 1:
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | (data << 8)
        else:
            self.regs[addr] = data
